title: Exact CATALOG_DRAFT Payload JSON string contents

expectedCloudVersion.description: Firestore document updateTime from the authenticated catalog read, passed verbatim as currentDocument.updateTime; not content_version and never a locally generated placeholder.

imageUrl.description: Empty or credential-free HTTPS URI; no local path, data URL or unapproved hosted upload.

$comment: Require draft.id == storeId in server code. Do not infer or create a product if expectedCloudVersion is missing or the document does not exist. This exact POS adapter fills nameEn/category with placeholders, which MUST NOT overwrite the existing cloud values. stock_quantity=null is a sentinel for no stock update, not a Firestore field deletion. Server should use an explicit update mask, preserve all unrelated commercial/import/stock fields, and reset public/review gates deliberately. Do not full-document set().
